posts.body:
Hello Moms of Multiples out there,

I am pregnant with twins and they are my first! I am at the half way mark now (20 weeks) and would like to join a group or meet other expecting and/or recent new moms in my area. I live at North Point so, please write back if you are nearby.

Thank you.

Amy

posts.body:
Hi Amy,

Congratulations on your twins! We are also expecting twins (our first children) in November, born via an amazing surrogate mother in the US. I realise that since I am not pregnant my situation is very different from yours, but I would still love to meet up for a chat if you are interested. I live in Mid-Levels, so not far from North Point at all. I have to admit that raising twins in HK seems quite daunting! Feel free to message me

Wishing you all the best,

Stephanie

posts.body: Hello! I just found out im expecting twins, young first time mum living in wan chai. Have only lived in Hong Kong for 2years and seriously considering going back to Australia to deliver :/ I'm due January 2015, so still super early... But I am so scared! Parents are back in oz and I had a massive scare last week and ended up at the ER

posts.body:
Sorry this is late

Hello,

Sorry I got back to you late! I know the feeling cos my parents are back in Canada and I wish they could be here to help out. Especially with 2 babies to come! But we are looking at other options: part-time helper (maid) etc. I was thinking about going home to deliver as well but having twins convinced me to stay here for the birth. I have very good medical coverage and they are taking very good care of me cos of twins. Back home, I would probably get less medical attention ;P. I was also in ER in May and ended up being admitted for 3 days. Everything was ok though but it was a bit of a scare! If you fancy meeting up or for a chat, just gimme a shout. My tel is 9169 1976 and I am on whatsapp.

Take care, Amy
